translations./garage/brief: An ion storm is swallowing the valley. Choose your equipment, then decide the recovery order for three signal cores. RO-1 senses, plans, avoids hazards, and drives autonomously. Every recovered core changes mass, center of gravity, and the risks ahead.
translations./prediction/hint: The flood route is short but loses grip. The ridge raises the center of gravity. The shadow yard combines occlusion with moving service carts. Commit to a hypothesis, then let the evidence answer.
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: A heavy low load increases braking distance, while its lower center of gravity may help on the later cross-slope.
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Crossing the ridge early avoids its worst grip, while the high load changes rollover margin on every later leg.
translations./prediction/choices/2/feedback: A light vehicle is agile around traffic, but occlusion still demands time-aligned prediction.
translations./running/normal_line: Select a glowing core. You own the goal and order; RO-1 owns every driving action.
translations./running/detected_line: RO-1 is reassessing a safe route from LiDAR, map geometry, predicted motion, and current payload.
translations./debrief/success_title: The Three Cores Relit the Base
translations./debrief/success_summary: Compare the actual order, payload history, minimum clearance, slip, energy, and storm stage to explain why the same map produced different risks.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Find the first margin that disappeared: route, dynamic gap, grip, braking, cross-slope, or time. Retry the same seed with one changed decision.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Task order, physical payload, weather, sensing, planning, and vehicle state come from one deterministic run.
translations./debrief/knowledge_title: Goal Selection and Motion Planning Are Different Layers
translations./debrief/failure_titles/collision-static: Protocol failed: struck a fixed structure
translations./debrief/failure_titles/collision-dynami: Protocol failed: collided with a service cart
translations./debrief/failure_titles/rollover: Protocol failed: payload and cross-slope exhausted rollover margin
translations./debrief/failure_titles/timeout: Protocol failed: the storm window closed
translations./debrief/failure_titles/no-feasible-rout: Protocol failed: no feasible route to the selected core
translations./debrief/failure_titles/payload-damage: Protocol failed: core shock exceeded tolerance
translations./debrief/failure_titles/return-reserve: Protocol failed: return margin was insufficient
translations./running/goal_lines/2: Storm intensifying: choose the final core
